basis: The dashboard legend maps the dark burgundy color to the 'High' prevalence end (near 0) and pale yellow to the 'Low' end (near 100). Among the available options, New York (NY) is filled with the dark burgundy color, indicating the highest prevalence. North Carolina (NC) and Delaware (DE) are filled with pale yellow and light orange, respectively, indicating lower prevalence. Therefore, NY is the state that meets the routing criterion for the highest-prevalence priority follow-up workflow.
option_label: Open New York (NY) prevalence detail for priority follow-up
